_readme: SAIRNlaw deadline engine seed -- North Dakota (N.D.R.Civ.P., N.D.R.Ct. 3.2, N.D.R.App.P. 4).
Gate: docs/sairnlaw-northdakota-deadline-seed-gate.md (hank b63, 2026-10-28). Every value read verbatim from
ndcourts.gov on 2026-10-28 and quoted in its row. Every reading not compelled by the text resolves EARLY.

authority.quote: a defendant must serve an answer within 21 days after being served with the summons and complaint
authority.note: NO service_extension: 6(e)(2) -- "If service is made by mail or third-party commercial carrier under Rule 4, the prescribed period begins running upon delivery." The trigger date IS the delivery date. effective_from is the current text's published effective date (or Rule 6's, 2018-03-01, where the rule's own was not traced); a matter triggered earlier should have the then-current text confirmed by hand.

rules.label: Answer to a counterclaim or crossclaim (North Dakota)

authority.quote: a party must serve an answer to a counterclaim or crossclaim within 21 days after being served with the pleading that states the counterclaim or crossclaim
authority.note: Rule 5 service between parties, so 6(e) reaches it. effective_from is the current text's published effective date (or Rule 6's, 2018-03-01, where the rule's own was not traced); a matter triggered earlier should have the then-current text confirmed by hand.

service_extension.note: N.D.R.Civ.P. 6(e)(1): "service is made by mail or third-party commercial carrier under Rule 5, three days are added after the prescribed period would otherwise expire under N.D.R.Civ.P. 6(a)." AFTER expiry -- the federal order. Electronic service earns nothing.

rules.label: Answers and objections to interrogatories (North Dakota)

authority.quote: The responding party must serve its answer and any objections within 30 days after being served with the interrogatories, but a defendant is not required to serve its answer and any objections until 45 days after service of the summons and complaint on it.
authority.note: THE 30-DAY LIMB. The defendant's 45-day floor is NOT computed: where it governs the true date is LATER, so this row is earlier-or-equal. Stipulated or ordered times are not visible. effective_from is the current text's published effective date (or Rule 6's, 2018-03-01, where the rule's own was not traced); a matter triggered earlier should have the then-current text confirmed by hand.

service_extension.note: N.D.R.Civ.P. 6(e)(1): "service is made by mail or third-party commercial carrier under Rule 5, three days are added after the prescribed period would otherwise expire under N.D.R.Civ.P. 6(a)." AFTER expiry -- the federal order. Electronic service earns nothing.

rules.label: Response to a request for production (North Dakota)

authority.quote: The party to whom the request is directed must respond in writing within 30 days after being served, but a defendant is not required to serve its response until 45 days after being served with the summons and complaint.
authority.note: THE 30-DAY LIMB; the 45-day defendant floor is not computed (EARLY). effective_from is the current text's published effective date (or Rule 6's, 2018-03-01, where the rule's own was not traced); a matter triggered earlier should have the then-current text confirmed by hand.

service_extension.note: N.D.R.Civ.P. 6(e)(1): "service is made by mail or third-party commercial carrier under Rule 5, three days are added after the prescribed period would otherwise expire under N.D.R.Civ.P. 6(a)." AFTER expiry -- the federal order. Electronic service earns nothing.

rules.label: Response to a request for admission (North Dakota)

authority.quote: A matter is admitted unless, within 30 days after being served, the party to whom the request is directed serves on the requesting party a written answer or objection addressed to the matter and signed by the party or its attorney.
authority.note: A missed date ADMITS the matter. The 45-day defendant floor is not computed (EARLY). effective_from is the current text's published effective date (or Rule 6's, 2018-03-01, where the rule's own was not traced); a matter triggered earlier should have the then-current text confirmed by hand.

service_extension.note: N.D.R.Civ.P. 6(e)(1): "service is made by mail or third-party commercial carrier under Rule 5, three days are added after the prescribed period would otherwise expire under N.D.R.Civ.P. 6(a)." AFTER expiry -- the federal order. Electronic service earns nothing.

rules.label: Answer brief opposing a motion (North Dakota)

authority.quote: the opposing party must have 14 days after service of a brief within which to serve and file an answer brief and other supporting papers
authority.note: Computed under Civ.R. 6(a), which governs "any local rule, court order, or statute that does not specify a method"; 6(e) reaches it as a period after Rule 5 service. effective_from is the current text's published effective date (or Rule 6's, 2018-03-01, where the rule's own was not traced); a matter triggered earlier should have the then-current text confirmed by hand.

service_extension.note: N.D.R.Civ.P. 6(e)(1): "service is made by mail or third-party commercial carrier under Rule 5, three days are added after the prescribed period would otherwise expire under N.D.R.Civ.P. 6(a)." AFTER expiry -- the federal order. Electronic service earns nothing.

rules.label: Reply brief on a motion (North Dakota)

authority.quote: The moving party may serve and file a reply brief within seven days after service of the answer brief.
authority.note: Seven calendar days: North Dakota excludes no intermediate weekends at any length. effective_from is the current text's published effective date (or Rule 6's, 2018-03-01, where the rule's own was not traced); a matter triggered earlier should have the then-current text confirmed by hand.

service_extension.note: N.D.R.Civ.P. 6(e)(1): "service is made by mail or third-party commercial carrier under Rule 5, three days are added after the prescribed period would otherwise expire under N.D.R.Civ.P. 6(a)." AFTER expiry -- the federal order. Electronic service earns nothing.

rules.label: Motion for a new trial, grounds other than newly discovered evidence (North Dakota)

authority.quote: A motion for a new trial must be served and filed no later than the following time after notice of entry of judgment: (1) on the ground of newly discovered evidence, within six months; and (2) on any other ground, within 60 days, unless the court, for good cause shown, extends the time.
authority.note: NO service_extension, BY READING (EARLY): "after notice of entry" may reach a mailed notice under 6(e), but adding days a rule may not give is LATE; in the bundled lawyer's question. The six-month (c)(1) limb is not seeded. effective_from is the current text's published effective date (or Rule 6's, 2018-03-01, where the rule's own was not traced); a matter triggered earlier should have the then-current text confirmed by hand.

rules.label: Notice of appeal in a civil case (North Dakota)

authority.quote: In a civil case, except as provided in paragraph (a)(4), the notice of appeal required by Rule 3 must be filed with the clerk of the supreme court within 60 days from service of notice of entry of the judgment or order being appealed.
authority.note: Runs from SERVICE of notice of entry, which App. R. 26(c) reaches expressly ("after being served"), so mail and commercial carrier take 3 days. Rule 4 is effective 9/1/2026; the (a)(2) 14-day multiple-appeal limb and the (a)(3) tolling motions are not seeded. effective_from is the current text's published effective date (or Rule 6's, 2018-03-01, where the rule's own was not traced); a matter triggered earlier should have the then-current text confirmed by hand.

service_extension.note: N.D.R.App.P. 26(c): "When a party may or must act within a specified time after being served, three days must be added after the period would otherwise expire, unless the document is delivered on the date of service stated in the proof of service." Electronic service "is treated as delivered on the date of service", so it earns nothing.
